sections.heading: Your first expedition
sections.body: Lumo Ruins is your first normal combat area. Equip the weapon chosen from your Arms Chest, then start its battle from Shenic. Combat continues as an ongoing action.

sections.heading: Win an encounter
sections.body: Into the Ruins requires a victory in Lumo Ruins. Starting the action alone does not complete the objective. Return to Combat to inspect encounters and rewards, and follow the journal when the victory is recorded.

sections.heading: Equipment from victories
sections.body: Victories in normal areas can drop equipment for the region's tier. Dungeons use the same equipment pool with a higher drop rate and better odds for higher rarities.
